tagline.en: Budget travel eSIM for 200+ destinations with a free number from Hushed
tagline.zh: 200+ 目的地平价旅行 eSIM，附赠 Hushed 号码

description.en: aloSIM (from the Hushed team, Canada) sells budget data packs for 200+ destinations from $3.50, and bundles a free international phone number for calling and texting alongside the data eSIM.
description.zh: aloSIM（加拿大 Hushed 团队旗下）为 200+ 目的地销售 $3.50 起的平价流量包，购数据 eSIM 同时附赠一个可打电话发短信的国际号码。

validity.zh: 典型 7 天，按套餐不同

zh: 附赠 Hushed 号码可通话短信

details.en:
aloSIM is the travel eSIM brand from the Canadian Hushed team. Its differentiator: every data purchase bundles a free Hushed international number that can place calls and receive SMS - the ability to get verification codes is rare among data-only travel eSIMs. The site quotes 1M+ users and a 4.6-star rating across 28,531+ reviews.

Prices (homepage captured 2026-11-10): single-country packs from $3.50 (US/UK/France/Italy), Mexico $5.00, Europe $5.00, Asia $5.00, North America $5.50, Caribbean $6.50, Global $10.00; the FAQ puts 1GB at about $4.50. Entry packs are small - roughly 1GB for 7 days - aimed at light users.

Notes: the number lives in the Hushed app, so its features and top-up rules follow Hushed terms; regional packs start higher than single-country ones, so short single-country trips are better served by country packs. The full per-GB catalog lives in the app and could not be rendered on the website directly.
details.zh:
aloSIM 是加拿大 Hushed 团队推出的旅行 eSIM 品牌，最大差异点：购买流量包同时附赠一个 Hushed 国际号码，可打电话、收短信——在纯数据旅行 eSIM 里能收验证码是稀缺能力。站点自称 1M+ 用户、4.6 星（28,531+ 评价）。

价格（2026-11-10 首页实核）：美国/英国/法国/意大利单国包 $3.50 起，墨西哥 $5.00、欧洲区域 $5.00、亚洲 $5.00、北美 $5.50、加勒比 $6.50、全球 $10.00；FAQ 说明 1GB 约 $4.50 起。入门包普遍只有约 1GB、7 天有效，适合轻度用户。

使用注意：号码功能通过 Hushed App 提供，功能与续费规则以 Hushed 侧为准；区域包起价普遍高于单国包，短途单国游买单国更划算。逐 GB 完整价目表在 App 内，官网未能直接渲染。
